title: Comprehensive Evaluation (Behavioral Health)
about: The comprehensive evaluation every person receiving CCBHC services has, with the fifteen elements of SAMHSA's CCBHC criteria (4.d.4), completed within 60 calendar days of the first request (2.b.1) and building on the initial evaluation. It includes a mental status examination and the screens the criteria name. The clinician records their own diagnoses, coded in ICD-10-CM; the form suggests none. The treatment plan is made from it (4.e.2).

source.name: SAMHSA CCBHC Certification Criteria (2023, updated August 2025): 2.b.1 and 4.d.4

fields.label: Due by (60 calendar days after the first request)

blocks.text: Ask in the depth the person's needs call for, and follow their preferences about how much to go into.

blocks.label: Reasons for seeking services: when the symptoms began, how severe they are, and what led the person here
Social supports, family or caregivers, and the needs ticked
Cultural and environmental factors that may affect the treatment plan, including any need for language services
Pregnancy and parenting
items: Gave birth in the past year

blocks.label: Behavioral health history: trauma, past treatment and hospital stays, what helped and what did not
Medical history and major health conditions that affect the person's psychological state
Medicines and other treatments: prescriptions, over-the-counter medicines, herbal remedies and supplements, including any found in the prescription drug monitoring program (PDMP)

fields.label: Other measures for ongoing care: tool and score
Substance use, including tobacco, alcohol and other drugs: tool and result

blocks.label: Risks found
items: An urgent or critical medical condition

blocks.label: What was found, and what was done about it
Strengths, goals and preferences for treatment and recovery, in the person's words
Social service needs and referrals made (for a child or youth: child welfare or juvenile justice involvement, and any referral to child welfare)

fields.label: Need for a physical exam or further evaluation, including by the primary care provider, and the referral made

blocks.label: How the person would like care by technology
Diagnoses
columns: New, confirmed or changed since the initial evaluation

blocks.text: The diagnoses are the clinician's own, from this evaluation: the form suggests none.
